This avoids adapter-specific upsert predicates and serializes competing jobs through the document row. An existing embedding with a higher revision will be retained rather than overwritten.

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # The provider may be slow (and may itself cause a document to change), so
      # do not hold a database transaction while it runs.
      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)

      Document.transaction do
        # Lock by id rather than by the original tenant scope.  That makes a
        # tenant reassignment serialize with this check as well.
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id)
        unless current && current.tenant_id == tenant_id && current.published? &&
               current.revision == snapshot.revision
          next :discarded
        end

        embedding = Embedding.lock.find_by(document_id: document_id, version: version)
        # A result for a later revision may already have won this race.  Never
        # let this (older) provider result replace it.
        next :stored if embedding && embedding.revision > current.revision

        attributes = {
          document_id: document_id,
          tenant_id: current.tenant_id,
          revision: current.revision,
          version: version,
          vector: JSON.generate(vector)
        }

        if embedding
          embedding.update!(attributes)
        else
          Embedding.create!(attributes)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
